calling_convention.inputs: $fp points to the secondary object record; $t8 is the viewport height supplied by the caller
calling_convention.return: No explicit value; the observed type-0x1a path selects a palette and invokes renderer 0x880107a8

reads: packed-frame header and the packed row-size bytes walked during first-source-row selection, starting at frame + 8
viewport height at 0x88087b40; original entry 0x88001b90 first seeds this global from caller register $t8, while native descriptor preparation reads the seeded value
palette bank beginning at 0x88090100 plus the selected 0x100-byte bank
writes: selected palette-source global at 0x880359c8 and 0x100-byte working palette at 0x88090000 through helper 0x88001ffc

original.discovery_notes: For the controlled Endokuken impact, display class 0x60 and flags 0 route directly from this function to 0x880107a8. The partial native reconstruction resolves signed positions, optional 12-bit x/y scale multipliers, pixel direction, frame lookup/header, horizontal clip bounds, high-edge vertical rejection and packed-row walking, viewport, framebuffer bank, palette source, renderer mode/callback, and initial downscale row. Record bytes 0x8e and 0x97 are zero in all observed calls; nonzero values are explicitly unsupported because their alternate mode-0x60 palette semantics are not yet verified. Palette-copy side effects, negative-palette special handling, other display classes, and nonzero flag branches remain outside this evidence boundary.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -debugscript mame/trace_ki15d_type1a_state_to_render.cmd -autoboot_script mame/autoplay_jago_vs_idle_fulgore.lua -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 35 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff -oslog
verification.notes: Two independent controlled traces have identical KI_S2R lines. The analyzer recomputes every declared transform for 315 calls across 96 displayed ticks. Native guest-state preparation matches every descriptor field for all 315 calls, including zero-valued record bytes 0x8e and 0x97. First, six ordered peak calls, and final-call synthetic framebuffer comparisons give identical oracle/state hash 1a8693d815eebeed. Synthetic boundary tests cover the statically recovered negative direction, exact reverse callback-table entries, left/both clipping, wholly and partly high-clipped vertical spans, combined high clipping/downscaling, and malformed or truncated row walks. Organic trace coverage remains positive direction with none/right clipping. Status remains partial because palette-copy side effects, nonzero 0x8e/0x97 palette behavior, negative-palette handling, alternate display classes, and nonzero flag branches are intentionally unsupported.
